newsitem.title: USA: Carnival lines to post record results in 96.
newsitem.headline: Carnival lines to post record results in 96.

text.p: Carnival Corp said Thursday "all four of the company's cruise lines are on track to post record results again in 1996."
The statement from Chief Executive and Chairman Micky Arison came after the company reported record-level revenues and earnings for the third quarter.

The company reported net income of $268.1 million, or $0.92 earnings per share, for the third quarter ended August 31, compared to net income of $209.5 million, or $0.74 earnings per share, for the year-ago period.

The company attributed operating results in the third quarter to increased capacity from the introduction of Carnival Cruise Lines' Inspiration in March and Holland America Line's Veendam in June and to a modest improvement in net revenue yields during the quarter.
The third quarters of 1996 and 1995 included gains from litigation settlements relating to the Wartsila Marine bankruptcy, the company said.
Arison said the fourth quarter is traditionally the toughest for the industry, but that all the company's lines should produce record results for the year.
